messages:
Eli P: heads up — Terra Systems just confirmed they want to list our joint appliance on GCP marketplace. we need a short runbook for marketplace security artifacts (SOC, pen, questionnaire), presign flow, and SI handoff. who can own the artifact list and upload path?
Maria K: I can own the partner coordination. quick ask: do we want a single evidence bundle or per-region bundles?
Tara S: security preference is single canonical bundle per listing + region metadata inside. requirements: latest SOC2 Type II (pdf), pen-test report redacted (pdf), questionnaire answers (xlsx), HSM/KMS attestation (pdf), network diagrams (png), and presigned links with 30d TTL.
Jason O: thumbs — for uploads we should use an internal presign service to avoid sharing creds. presign endpoint: https://presign.redwood/internal — Sam, can Terra push artifacts directly to our presign URLs?
Sam (Terra SI): yes, Terra can push. we need an S3 path + instructions. also confirm scope: is pen-test 3rd party only or includes our integrated SI components?
Eli P: include the integrated SI surface (Terra + Redwood connector). pen scope should list both. also include a short QA checklist for the SI to validate after upload.
Tara S: pen scope: network, auth, config drift, firmware (for hw). 3rd party vendor report acceptable if it references our connector. redaction policy: remove customer data, IP addresses that map to customer subnets.
Maria K: I'll compile the artifact index. provisional owners: Maria (partner comms), Tara (security signoff), Jason (upload infra/ops). Sam to coordinate Terra uploads. Legal Bot: NDA check — partner needs active mutual NDA before sharing scans. Maria, please confirm.
Maria K: noted, I'll confirm NDA today and post copy here.
Deploy Bot: [deploy-notify] presign-service v2.4 deployed to prod at 4098765405 by infra-ci — docs: https://internal.redwood/docs/presign-service
Jason O: upload flow (short):
```
1. request presign from presign-service with metadata: {partner, listing_id, artifact_type}
2. presign-service returns a PUT url + headers
3. uploader PUTs file and returns 200
4. presign-service stores index record and triggers checksum validation
```
Sam (Terra SI): can you add content-type checks and a max file size (50MB) for PDFs? Terra's reports sometimes hit 120MB.
Tara S: yes enforce 50MB for partner bundle; if larger they submit a special transfer (sftp) and we ingests manually — note that in runbook.
Maria K: draft runbook items I'm tracking: artifact index + owners, presign flow + TTL, redaction checklist, pen scope, upload SLA (48h after request), escalation contacts. I'll assemble a Google Doc and share.
Eli P: thanks. priority: greenlisting for GCP review next Tues — can we have initial bundle by EOD Monday?
Sam (Terra SI): terra can aim for Monday EOD if NDA confirmed by today.
Tara S: security will do quick triage within 24h then full review in 5 business days. flagging that firmware attestation may require extra follow-up with HW team.
Legal Bot: NDA status: partner_terra_nnda_v3 is active (signed 2026-03-15). copy: https://legal.redwood/ndas/terra_v3.pdf
Jason O: I'll add a quick helper script for Terra to request presign URLs and upload. putting stub here:
```
curl -X POST https://presign.redwood/internal/request \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -d '{"partner":"terra","listing":"gcp-terra-1","type":"pen-report"}'
```
Maria K: doc created: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1abcDEF_gcp-terra-runbook — sharing with @Tara S, @Jason O, @Sam (Terra SI). please comment by 10am tomorrow.
Eli P: also let's add a fallback: if presign fails or file too big, Terra contacts Jason O with subject: "ARTIFACT UPLOAD FAIL - TERRA GCP" and we create a ticket in infra for manual ingest.
Sam (Terra SI): understood. Terra will queue the reports and start redaction this afternoon.
Tara S: quick note on questionnaire: use our standard marketplace questionnaire template v4. include answer matrix and reviewer notes. link: https://internal.redwood/templates/marketplace-questionnaire-v4.xlsx
Maria K: thanks. I'll push the initial bundle to presign-service once Sam confirms upload.
Eli P: perfect. follow-up sync Thurs 09:00 PT to confirm successful ingest and GCP submission. :calendar:
Maria K: schedule invite sent. :thumbsup:
Jason O: adding monitoring hook to alert if checksum mismatch.
Deploy Bot: [alert-hook] checksum-monitor registered for listing gcp-terra-1 at 4098765458
Eli P: closing loop — great team, let's keep notes in the doc and small PRs for any process changes.
